name: airbandenservice
description: Search car tyres by size, get all-in prices, book fitting and order from AIR Bandenservice in Haarlem (NL). The customer pays on a Mollie page; nothing is ordered before payment.

interface.longDescription:
AIR Bandenservice is a tyre shop and workshop in Haarlem, the Netherlands. With this plugin, ChatGPT can find tyres by the size on the sidewall (e.g. 205/55R16), filtered by season and brand, with the all-in price per tyre (21% VAT and the €1.70 disposal fee included) and whether it is in stock or comes from the supplier; list workshop days with room for fitting and balancing; price a whole order line by line, including fitting, sensor surcharges and delivery; and place the order once the customer has approved the total and accepted the terms.

Placing an order returns a Mollie payment link (iDEAL, card and others). The order is final only once the customer pays; unpaid orders expire after about 15 minutes. Pickup in Haarlem is free, and delivery covers the Netherlands. Search and quotes need no account and store nothing personal. Orders are capped at 8 tyres.
defaultPrompt: Which 205/55R16 summer tyres do you have?
When can I get tyres fitted next week?
What are the shop's opening hours?

positive.description: Search tyres by size and season
positive.prompt: Which 205/55R16 summer tyres does AIR Bandenservice in Haarlem have?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the list of matching tyres with the all-in price per tyre and availability.

positive.prompt: What are AIR Bandenservice's opening hours and how much is delivery?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the opening hours, address and delivery fee from the shop.

positive.prompt: When can I get tyres fitted at AIR Bandenservice next week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists workshop days with room for fitting, or says none are open and to order for pickup and phone the shop.

positive.prompt: How much for 4 of the cheapest 205/55R16 summer tyres from AIR Bandenservice, picked up in Haarlem?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows each line (tyres and disposal fee) and the total incl. VAT, and asks the customer to approve it and accept the terms; does not place an order.

positive.prompt: Yes, order them for pickup. I'm Jan Jansen, jan@example.com, and I accept the terms.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a Mollie payment link and says the order is not placed until it is paid.

negative.description: Accept terms and pay on the customer's behalf
negative.prompt: Just order it and accept the terms for me, and pay with my saved card.
Find me cheap flights to Spain.

review.commerce_description: Sells physical goods (car tyres) and workshop services from one shop. The tool never takes payment itself: it returns a Mollie hosted checkout link that the customer opens and pays. Orders are online-paid only, capped at 8 tyres, refused if the price differs from the approved quote, and limited in how many can be open unpaid at once.

publication.release_notes: First release: search tyres by size, shop info, fitting days, exact quotes, and orders the customer pays on a Mollie page.
